name: Hanamaru Momoko
source:
The eldest sister.

She is married and has children but moved back home to her parents' home. She is mainly in charge of cooking and laundry, and is regarded as the most level headed person in the house.

The reason she returned home due to "poor health" is a ruse. There are rumors that she is having difficulties with her "night life" with her husband. She still tries to be amicable and caring when the possibility of divorce is running through her mind.

Not too long ago, her daughter was born. Her name is Natsume.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/ane&boin/chara/momoko.htm]official site[/url]]
